units.text: INT. CANDLE-MAKER'S WORKSHOP - LONDON - NIGHT, 1666
A low timber room that smells of tallow and smoke.
Cauldrons of molten wax squat on iron tripods.
Rows of tapers hang from the rafters like pale stalactites.
Through the shuttered window comes a dull orange glow that is not sunrise.
MASTER EZEKIEL THORNE (60s, apron stiff with wax, beard singed at the tips) stands at a vat, stirring with both hands as though his life depended on it.
His wife, MISTRESS AGNES THORNE (50s, severe, with a ring of keys at her belt) drags a chest across the floor.
Their apprentice, ALDOUS PEEL (16, thin, ink-stained fingers) crouches beside the window, peering through a crack.
Near the hearth, MERCY FAIRWEATHER (20s, a lodger, shawl pulled tight, a bird in a wicker cage clutched to her chest) huddles in silence.
And in the doorway, framed against the night, stands CAPTAIN BARNABY LOCKE (40s, soot-blackened coat, a constable's staff) breathing like a bellows.
The wind has turned! It comes down Pudding Lane toward you! Out, all of you, now!
units.name: LOCKE

units.text: Forty years I have poured wax in this room.
units.name: EZEKIEL

units.text: Ezekiel.
units.name: AGNES

units.text: Forty years, and never a fire.
units.name: EZEKIEL

units.text: There is a fire now, you stubborn goat.
units.name: AGNES

units.text: Master, the glow has reached the baker's roof.
units.name: ALDOUS

units.text: Hush, boy.
units.name: EZEKIEL

units.text: It is not hushing, sir. It is coming.
units.name: ALDOUS

units.text: Mercy's bird chirps, a small frantic sound.
She presses her cheek against the cage.
Hush, hush, hush.
units.name: MERCY

units.text: There is a boat at Queenhithe. I can take four.
units.name: LOCKE

units.text: We are five.
units.name: AGNES

units.text: Then someone must find another way.
units.name: LOCKE

units.text: A silence.
Agnes looks at her husband, at the wax, at the girl with the bird.
Ezekiel finally sets down the paddle.
Everyone take what they can carry. Leave the rest.
units.name: EZEKIEL

units.text: You will carry me, then.
units.name: AGNES

units.text: I will carry the chest.
units.name: EZEKIEL

units.text: We are leaving the chest!
units.name: AGNES

units.text: It holds the deed.
units.name: EZEKIEL

units.text: Aldous grabs a bundle of tapers.
Mercy rises with her cage.
Locke steps aside as they hurry past, one by one, into the street.
Ezekiel is last.
He stops at the threshold and looks back at the vats, the rafters, the pale rows of unlit candles.
Burn bright, then. Burn bright.
units.name: EZEKIEL

units.text: He shoulders the chest and goes out.
The doorway fills with orange light.
